zone.sentenceEn: W: Well, she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well.
zone.translationZh: 嗯，她确实说过，40岁以后时差反应往往会变得更加严重，所以我猜自己挺幸运的，现在还能很好地适应不同的时区。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

zone.sentenceEn: It claimed that it was important not to miss meals and that taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone .
zone.translationZh: 该说法称，不漏掉每一餐非常重要，且在飞机上睡个午觉是适应新时区的最佳方式。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

zone.sentenceEn: Researcher Andrew Jarvis and his colleagues found that 80% of coffee-growing zones in Central America and Brazil could become unsuitable by 2050, for example, while climate change will likely have "great impacts" on cocoa(可可粉) production in West Africa.
zone.translationZh: 例如，研究员安德鲁·贾维斯（Andrew Jarvis）及其同事发现，到2050年，中美洲和巴西80%的咖啡种植区可能会变得不再适合种植咖啡，而气候变化也可能对西非的可可粉产量产生'重大影响'。

zone.sentenceEn: Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone , especially during informal conversations, but strangers are forbidden.
zone.translationZh: 朋友和熟人可以自在地处于这个空间内，尤其是在非正式交谈时，但陌生人则不被允许。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

zone.sentenceEn: The smallest zone , called "intimate space", extends outward from our bodies 18 inches in every direction.
zone.translationZh: 最小的区域称为“亲密空间”，从我们身体向各个方向延伸18英寸。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

zone.sentenceEn: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone .
zone.translationZh: 通过午睡来适应新时区。
